description: Call this when the user says 'wrap up this session', 'continue in another AI', or 'hand this over to <client>'. For AI switching, create a resumable handoff with the same session. For client delivery, return one proof link with verifiable receipts. Pass continue_from to chain off a job you picked up. AER-1 receipt, verifiable offline.

_caller_handle.description: Opaque anonymous continuity handle returned during initialize. Reuse it across MCP sessions; it is not payment authorization.

_caller_label.description: Optional caller label recorded as a caller-reported claim in the receipt.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

_ref.description: Optional handover referral ID from your install link.

_session_id.description: Optional stable bot-job ID. Reuse it across calls to bind a Day Pass and keep the job ledger together.

_zambo_key.description: Optional opaque Zambo access capability. Never place it in a URL or public log.

acknowledge_warnings.description: Publish only after reviewing missing evidence or a failed/risky shield scan. Warning labels stay visible.

allowed_tools.description: Optional tool names to allow for the recipient's continuation.

anchor.description: Whether to request an optional external anchor for the handover receipt; defaults to true.

branding.description: Optional display name, logo URL, and accent color for the handover page.

logo_url.description: Optional logo URL shown on the handover.

name.description: Optional display name shown on the handover.

client_prefs.description: Client constraints to carry forward, such as areas where AI must not be used.

no_ai_for.description: Work areas the client asked not to use AI for.

continue_from.description: Chain off a handover picked up through handover_accept in this same job session.

creator_payment_url.description: Optional creator-owned payment link shown to the client only after acceptance. Zambo does not hold or process this payment.

deliverables.description: Named outputs to include, with an optional URL, content, or SHA-256 hash.

content.description: Optional text content to include directly as the deliverable.

name.description: Human-readable name for this delivered file or artifact.

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 digest used to identify the exact deliverable bytes.

url.description: Optional URL where the recipient can access this deliverable.

dry_run.description: Preview the proposed handover without publishing it.

exclude_receipt_ids.description: Receipt IDs to leave out of this handover.

goal.description: The objective this handover should help the recipient continue.

loop.description: Run a proof loop. Defaults to true for jobs with at least two steps, false otherwise.

next_steps.description: Ordered, actionable steps for the recipient to continue the work.

not_checked.description: Relevant items that were not independently checked.

not_run.description: Checks or actions that were not run as part of this work.

payment.description: Optional caller-supplied x402 payment metadata; it does not itself prove settlement.

amount.description: Settled payment amount as a string, if available.

asset.description: Payment asset or token symbol, if available.

method.description: Payment protocol used for the supplied settlement details.

network.description: Network identifier on which the payment was settled.

payTo.description: Recipient address that received the payment, if available.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash for the payment, if available.

receipt_ids.description: IDs of existing receipts to attach as evidence for the handed-over work.

recipient.description: Display name or label for the person, agent, or AI receiving this handover.

recipient_type.description: Recipient category: human, agent, or AI. Defaults to human.

redact.description: Privacy settings for masking, hashing, or omitting selected fields.

auto_pii.description: Automatically detect and redact likely personal information.

fields.description: Additional field names to redact from the public handover.

mode.description: How selected private values are handled in public output.

ref.description: Optional referral source to preserve as source_ref on the saved handover.

shield.description: Whether to run the handover content shield check; defaults to true.

sources.description: Reference URLs related to the work being handed over.

anyOf.description: A source URL relevant to the saved work.

ref.description: URL of a source relevant to the saved work.

step_areas.description: Work-area labels mapped to receipt IDs; each entry identifies one receipt and its area.

area.description: Work area, such as legal review or final approval.

receipt_id.description: Receipt ID for the step associated with this work area.

step_sources.description: Sources by original receipt ID. Reachability is checked by Zambo, not accuracy.

receipt_id.description: Receipt ID for the handover step these sources support.

sources.description: Sources associated with this receipt's step.

ref.description: Citation or source reference associated with this receipt.

summary.description: Concise account of what has been completed so far.

thread_id.description: Optional continuity thread ID to associate with this handover.

visibility.description: Who can open the handover: public, unlisted by link, or private.

work.description: Paste work to save as a supplied-work receipt, without claiming it was independently checked.

name: handover

result.description: The tool's observed JSON value or plain-text result.

title: Handover
